fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' sends '''{{ci|Valor}}''' in the target direction who stops upon hitting an enemy, marking them with ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}'' and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies, increased to 200% against {{tip|monsters}}.
fields.description2: The primary target is {{tip|nearsight|nearsighted}} for {{fd|1.75}} seconds if they are a {{tip|champion}}, and {{tip|disarm|disarmed}} for the same duration otherwise.
fields.notes:
* ''Blinding Assault's'' {{tip|nearsight}} will persist through {{tip|death}}.
